newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: RUGBY UNION-Fitzy revs up his troops.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-Fitzy revs up his troops.

text.p: DUNEDIN, Aug 15 - Sean Fitzpatrick maybe the rugby public's No 1 bore when it comes to words, NZPA reports.
But he intends leaving nothing to chance for a stirring dressing room session before the All Blacks run onto Carisbrook tomorrow for their final home test of the year against the Wallabies.
Fitzpatrick will be brief, sharp, precise and hopefully piercing when he'll urge his troop for one final effort for themselves, their families and friends and the faithful followers of the team.
"Remember Ellis Park and Eden Park, you don't want that dissatisfaction," the warrior will tell them.
The All Blacks came from behind to beat the Springboks 35-32 at Ellis Park, but the dressing room resembled a funeral scene as players sat and reflected on their unhappy efforts.
"We knew in ourselves we didn't play well," Ian Jones said.
"We won but that's not how we wanted the victory."
Even their record 55-35 victory in the return clash with the Springboks at Eden Park last week left them with a hollow feeling.
They rued the grand chance for a concerted effort wasn't exploited.
"I don't think they want to be left with a similar feeling this week," Fitzpatrick said.
The Otago Daily Times has got into the spirit of the test, urging its readers to give the fullhouse (42,000) Carisbrook some colour by wearing black to the park tomorrow.
